description: Bike share and scooter share metrics from gbfs_exporter.

panels.description: UP when the exporter read every feed that the system publishes.
panels.title: System

panels.description: Stations of the selected system.
panels.title: Stations

panels.description: Vehicles at stations that a rider can take.
panels.title: Vehicles available

panels.description: Docks that accept a vehicle.
panels.title: Free docks

panels.description: Vehicles at stations that a rider cannot take.
panels.title: Vehicles disabled

panels.description: Vehicles at stations divided by the capacity of the stations that report both a capacity and a vehicle count. The old ratio divided by the free docks, which reported a car system with no free docks as permanently full.
panels.title: Occupancy (derived)

panels.description: The whole network measured against its capacity. Vehicles a rider can take, stacked on the docks that accept a vehicle, then on the space that does neither. The three reach the capacity line. The third band is derived by subtraction, because no GBFS field states it: for a car sharing system it is mostly cars out on rental, and for a docked bike system it is broken docks or bikes. Every figure covers the stations that report both a capacity and a vehicle count.
panels.title: Vehicles and space

panels.description: The share of capacity holding a vehicle a rider can take, over time. This is the daily cycle of the network: it climbs overnight as vehicles come back and falls through the commute.
panels.title: Occupancy over time

panels.description: A station is empty when it holds no vehicle. A station is full when it has no free dock. The full count is left out for an operator that reports no free docks anywhere, because every station would read as full. Citiz is one: it reports zero docks at all 293 stations.
panels.title: Empty and full stations

panels.description: Vehicles listed in the vehicle feed. A docked system need not publish that feed at all, and Oslo and Trondheim do not.

defaults.noValue: This system publishes no vehicle feed.

panels.title: Vehicles in the feed

panels.description: Vehicles in the vehicle feed. Some operators list docked vehicles here too.
panels.title: Vehicle feed over time

panels.description: The vehicles a rider can take in the vehicle feed, by form factor and drive. The drive is the only field that tells an electric bicycle from a classic one.

defaults.noValue: This system publishes no vehicle feed.

panels.title: Vehicle feed by drive

panels.description: Every station, coloured by the number of vehicles that a rider can take.

targets.expr:
gbfs_station_vehicles_available{system=~"$system"}
  * on (system, station_id) group_left (station_name, lat, lon) gbfs_station_info{system=~"$system"}

panels.title: Stations map

panels.description: Every station of the selected system. Click a column header to sort. Free docks counts the docks that accept a vehicle.
panels.title: All stations

panels.description: Stations with at least one service flag off. GBFS carries three: is_installed says the station stands on the street, is_renting says it gives vehicles out, and is_returning says it takes them back. A flag the operator omits is not counted.

defaults.noValue: No station publishes a service flag.

targets.expr:
count(min by (station_id) ({__name__=~"gbfs_station_(installed|renting|returning)", system=~"$system"}) == 0)
  or (count(min by (station_id) ({__name__=~"gbfs_station_(installed|renting|returning)", system=~"$system"})) * 0)

panels.title: Stations out of service

panels.description: Each flag counted separately over time. A station can stand on the street and still refuse to give a vehicle out or take one back.
panels.title: Stations out of service over time

panels.description: Which stations are not fully in service, and which flag is off. A station flat at zero vehicles reads as demand until this table shows that it stopped renting, and then it is a fault.

defaults.noValue: Every station is fully in service.

panels.title: Stations not fully in service

panels.description: The vehicle types that the operator publishes. The drive is the only field that tells an electric vehicle from one that is not, because a classic bicycle and an electric bicycle share the form factor.
panels.title: Vehicle types

panels.description: What stands at the stations, by form factor and drive. This needs a module with per_vehicle_type set, so a system configured without one shows nothing.

defaults.noValue: This system reports no per-type breakdown at stations.

panels.title: Vehicles at stations by drive

panels.description: The overall state of the system, and the state of each feed. A feed that the system does not publish gets no row.
panels.title: Feed state

panels.description: Metadata that the system publishes.
panels.title: System information
